resources.string: Netbird runs in the RexPocket Netbird add-on, a separate app beside this one. RexPocket starts it when it joins.
The Netbird add-on is not installed. Install %1$s from the same release or CI run as this app: the two must be signed with the same key.
RexPocket may not use the Netbird add-on: the two were signed with different keys. Install both from the same release or CI run.
The Netbird add-on did not answer.
The Netbird add-on speaks version %1$d of its interface, and this RexPocket version %2$d. Install both from the same release or CI run.
The Netbird add-on stopped. RexPocket is starting it again.
